title: Dungeon Idol Fans Gone Wild
description: Dungeon Idol Fans Gone Wild — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Chuck McBarris

Quest Type: Hunt

Quest Description: Slay 16 G'Rulksters in the upper branches of Frump's Misfortune, Deathtroit, H.E.L.L. A. and Cleaveland

Quest Reward: 6250 Gold

Return to: Chuck McBarris

Repeatable: Unknown

In-game text

Journal text, offer, and turn-in as they appeared in game.

Journal: Kill 16 G'Rulksters from the upper areas of Frump's Misfortune and return to Chuck McBarris in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort

Offer:

You have been keeping up with Dungeon Idol, right!? No! It is only the most important and educational show of our time! Here, let me get you caught up to the goings on in this truly life-changing show. A contestant named G'Rulk G'Rogan was recently voted off. Well you see, the problem was that he was favored to win this last round and a large following of his fans called G'Rulksters showed up. These G'Rulksters got worked up into a rage after watching him give a spectacular performance by racking up the Dungeon Runner kill counts only to end up losing out to Sanjyna due to not receiving as many votes.

They have been tearing up the sets and acting like unruly Dungeonball hooligans. All of our security staff has ended up in the hospital trying to stop them and the only applicants for some replacement muscle have been those double trouble Ice Mutant Twins. What are Twins going to do against the rampaging Hulks we have on our hands? Make them angry? Exactly! We don't like them now and we definitely won't like them when they are angry!

That is where you and your swivel arm kung fu action grip come into play. We need for you to travel through Frump's Misfortune and head into any of our locations found in the upper branches which are named Deathtroit, Cleaveland, and H.E.L.L.A. When you arrive at one of these locations, quickly begin to clear out the auditions of the G'Rulksters. Once you've managed to bounce the G'Rulksters out, come back to good 'ol Chuck McBarris here in Frump's Interdungeonal Resort.

Turn-in:

Too bad you only work as a freelancer. We could use a strong-arm like yourself around here. The way you handled those G'Rulksters was like some serious high quality Sunday Kung Fu. Not to mention our scrying crew recorded the whole thing and we are thinking of including the footage in our extras portion of the re-release of this season's show. Enough of the chit chat. Do you have some time to earn some more coin?

Objectives:

  • G'Rulksters sedated

Level range: 25–45
